note: docs/30 law 2 (Michael's OSRS rule): anything can be used on anything and the default is 'Nothing interesting happens.' A row here replaces that with an outcome. `use` is an item id or tag; `on` is an item id or tag, a prop's sprite id, 'character' | 'zombie' | 'villager', a floor sprite id, or 'tile'. Until the big pass's step 3 runs actions, a row may carry only a `message`, which is printed to the log.

rows.message: You hold the torch to the fire. It is already burning.
The well's own menu fills it; this is just a note that the rule works.
